topic: scheduled drift detection between fork repos and their upstreams: cron-based HEAD comparison, catching forks that fall behind after upstream updates, and the on-miss playbook

subtopics.scope: Maintaining the fork inventory and PINNED.md as the source of truth for pinned SHAs, plus the fork-to-upstream map file that drives the check.
seed_queries: PINNED.md pinned commit SHA fork tracking github
fork to upstream mapping yaml pinned SHA inventory file

subtopics.scope: GitHub API mechanics for comparing fork HEAD against upstream HEAD: the compare endpoint, listing commits since a SHA, and counting commits between pins.
seed_queries: github api compare commits between fork and upstream
github rest api list commits since sha count commits behind

subtopics.scope: Verdict classification (synced / minor-lag / drifted) and choosing a commit-count threshold that balances noise against CVE risk.
seed_queries: stale pin drift threshold alerting software dependency lag
commit lag threshold alerting repository monitoring noise

subtopics.scope: GitHub Actions scheduled workflows for a daily drift cron: cron timing, off-peak scheduling, workflow_dispatch override, permissions, and artifact upload.
seed_queries: github actions schedule cron workflow best practices daily
github actions workflow_dispatch inputs upload artifact daily report

subtopics.scope: Filing issues or comments when drift is detected: the GitHub issues API, deduplication against open issues, and linking to a tracking issue.
seed_queries: github actions create issue automatically on failure
github api create issue deduplicate check existing open issue

subtopics.scope: Output formats for drift reports: human text, machine JSON, SARIF for code-scanning integration, plus artifact naming and retention.
seed_queries: sarif format github code scanning upload
github actions artifact retention policy json report

subtopics.scope: The response playbook when a fork has drifted: rebase or merge upstream, pin bump process, security backport urgency, and CVE-driven prioritization.
seed_queries: fork falls behind upstream rebase update process maintenance
security patch backport urgency fork cve prioritization

subtopics.scope: Tuning the drift threshold from baseline data and the phased rollout of a drift-detection automation (ship, observe, tighten).
seed_queries: tuning alert thresholds from baseline monitoring data
phased rollout automation threshold tightening observability

subtopics.scope: The same drift-detection pattern applied to other pin types: container base image digests, pinned GitHub Action SHAs, and dependency lockfiles.

pinned github action sha drift dependabot update detection
